I saved Tobias's note as a fact on Marrow Agrisupply: their 2026 renewal is 382 seats. The source is recorded as his message in #central-team.

I also replied in his thread to let him know it was noted.

That's fine here: a seat count is an operational fact, not a finance figure, so it can be shared with the account's team and with org-wide roles. My search found nothing already recorded that disagrees with it, but semantic search was down, so only exact keyword matches were checked.
